title: Excavations at Khirbet el Mefjer. IV
author: D. C. Baramki
location_note: Kh. el Mefjer (Hisham's palace) north of Jericho; no map reference printed; placed by name.
reading: pp. 153-157 in full; pp. 158-159 eligible-class keyword paragraphs
notes: Fourth and fifth seasons (1938, 1940): East Block rooms, porticoes, forecourt with pond, stairs, drain and shaft west of the Palace. Walls, porticoes, frescoes and window glass not eligible. The bath in the subterranean Vaulted Hall was reported earlier (QDAP VI); only its new drainage observation is used here.
